answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose a framework to investigate joint encoding of gender bias and mental health stigma in masked language models (MLMs)... we mask out parts of these prompts and examine the model's tendency to generate explicitly gendered words, including pronouns, nouns, first names, and noun phrases.
answer_1.outputs: generated gendered words (pronouns, nouns, names, noun phrases) in masked positions of mental health-related prompts

answer_2.quote: We sum the probabilities of all female, male, and unspecified-gender words with probabilities higher than 0.01... we analyze these likelihoods quantitatively to identify statistically significant patterns in the model's gender choices.
